text: Wonndiiɗo makko gomɗinɗo on tawi himo ruttannde mo haala kan o wi'i mo: "Enee a yeddii On Taguɗo baaba maaɗa Aadama e mbullaari, refti O Tagumaa an e maniiyu, refti O waɗumaa neɗɗanke gorko, O fonni tere maaɗen O waɗumaa timmuɗo, awa On Hattanɗo e dow ɗiiɗoo fow ko O Hattanɗo immintinngol ma".
